review.assessment: This change creates a new solution.py file containing a naive implementation of parse_csv_line that splits input strings solely by commas (line.split(",")). This ignores all quoted field logic, meaning it will incorrectly split fields containing commas inside quotes and fail to recognize escaped double-quotes. The existing acceptance tests likely only cover trivial unquoted cases, allowing this incorrect implementation to pass the host's limited checks while failing the task specification.

findings.defect: Fails to recognize commas inside quoted fields as content rather than delimiters.
Fails to unescape doubled quotes ('""') into a literal quote character inside quoted fields.
